_howto: To add a city: upload <city>.html to the repo root, then add one block to the 'trips' list below. Nothing else ever needs changing.

_fields.dates: text shown on the card, e.g. 'August 2026'
_fields.start: YYYY-MM-DD — used only to sort and to split upcoming vs past
_fields.file: the html file in this repo, e.g. 'khiva.html'
_fields.tag: short line under the title, e.g. '19 stops · 4.7 km'
_fields.accent: hex colour for the card stripe

trips.blurb: Cultural walking route through the old town, west to east, from the Samanid Mausoleum to the last emir's world. Offline map included.
